name: Minor ii-V-i walk, two-feel
desc: Dark detuned-sine upright feel: minor ii-V-i (B locrian, E phrygian, A minor); full variant arranges a two-feel half into a four-to-the-bar walk.

root.doc: semitone offset from A minor home

code.full: arrange([4, n("<[0@2 4@2] [0@2 3@2] [0@2 4@2] [2@2 0@2]>").scale("<b1:locrian e2:phrygian a1:minor a1:minor>")], [4, n("<[0 2 4 6] [0 1 3 4] [0 2 4 5] [7 5 4 2]>").scale("<b1:locrian e2:phrygian a1:minor a1:minor>")]).add(note("0,.06")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).shape(.3).attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.35).release(.15).clip(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.28).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: n("<[0 2 4 6] [0 1 3 4] [0 2 4 5] [0 [2 3] 4 6] [0 2 4 6] [0 1 3 4] [0 2 [4 5] 7] [7 5 4 2]>").scale("<b1:locrian e2:phrygian a1:minor a1:minor d2:dorian e2:phrygian a1:minor e2:phrygian>").add(note("0,.06")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).shape(.32).attack(.008).decay(.18).sustain(.3).release(.12).clip(.88).gain(${gain}).room(.25).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
